item.title: [翻译] Latent Space: Dreamer加盟Meta超级智能实验室：个人超级智能九月回望
item.description:
标签: #AI代理 #Meta #超级智能

摘要: Dreamer团队加盟Meta超级智能实验室，助力其"个人超级智能"愿景落地；文章同时梳理了近期AI领域的关键进展，包括Claude桌面自动化、智能体技术栈成熟及Meta在自我改进模型方面的研究突破。

原标题: [AINews] Dreamer joins Meta Superintelligence Labs — 9 month retro of Personal Superintelligence

By now we’re pretty used to LS Pod guests going on to great success, but today’s news is fast for even us -Nat and Alex at MSL have execuhired Dreamerjust days after we shipped their pod, barely 11 days after we recorded with them:

到目前为止，我们已经相当习惯 LS Pod 的嘉宾们取得巨大成功，但今天的消息即使对我们来说也太快了——MSL 的 Nat 和 Alex 在我们发布他们的播客仅几天后，也就是在我们录制完节目后仅仅 11 天，就execuhired（高管式雇佣）了 Dreamer：

We’re surprised, but not at all disappointed. If you can’t tellfrom the pod, we were immediately in love with the tech and the polish, but it was always going to be a long slog to build any consumer AI business and it is a very nice thing indeed to have Team Zuck on your side to push consumer distribution.

我们感到惊讶，但一点也不失望。如果你从播客中听不出来，我们对这项技术和它的精致度一见钟情，但构建任何消费级 AI 业务本来就是一个漫长的过程，能有 Team Zuck（扎克伯格团队）站在你这边推动消费级分销，确实是一件非常好的事情。

This is also approximately the 9 month anniversary of the MSL“Personal Superintelligence” Manifestofrom Zuck, which reads:

这也是 MSL（Meta Superintelligence Labs，Meta 超级智能实验室）"个人超级智能（Personal Superintelligence）"宣言发布约 9 周年的日子，该宣言写道：

As profound as the abundance produced by AI may one day be, an even more meaningful impact on our lives will likely come fromeveryone having a personal superintelligence that helps you achieve your goals, create what you want to see in the world, experience any adventure, be a better friend to those you care about, and grow to become the person you aspire to be.

尽管 AI 有朝一日可能产生的丰饶（abundance）是深远的，但对我们生活更有意义的影响可能来自每个人都能拥有一个个人超级智能，它帮助你实现目标、创造你想在世界中看到的事物、体验任何冒险、成为你关心的人的更好朋友，并成长为你想成为的人。

If trends continue, then you’d expect people to spend less time in productivity software, and more time creating and connecting.Personal superintelligence that knows us deeply, understands our goals, and can help us achieve them will be by far the most useful.

如果趋势继续发展，那么你会预期人们在生产力软件上花费的时间减少，而在创造和连接上花费的时间增多。深刻了解我们、理解我们目标并能帮助我们实现目标的个人超级智能将是最有用的。

Rewatch the Dreamer walkthrough and observe how Sidekick is your personal intelligent agent-of-agents whose main job is the latter sentence:

重新观看 Dreamer 的演示，观察 Sidekick 如何作为你的个人智能智能体（agent）代理者，其主要工作正是实现后一句话所描述的功能：

This execuhire (our term forthese licensing+hire-but-not-acquire deals) comes afterthe $2B Manus acquisition in December, also done in a matter of 10 days, which hadsimilarly impressive techand decent distribution, though perhaps with less of an “OS” and ecosystem heavy emphasis as Dreamer.

这次execuhire（我们对这种授权+雇佣而非收购的交易的称呼）发生在去年 12 月 Manus 以 20 亿美元被收购之后，那次交易也是在 10 天内完成的，Manus 同样拥有令人印象深刻的技术和不错的分销渠道，尽管可能在"OS"（操作系统）和生态系统方面的强调不如 Dreamer 那么重。

Combining the two teams makes for one of the most formidable consumeragent labson Earth, and it is pretty clear what kind of talent Nat Friedman is in the market for (if you give him a pass forVibes). If you are savvy enough… you should be able to tell what other kinds of companies might be up next. (register your predictions in the comments!)

将这两个团队结合起来，造就了地球上最令人生畏的消费级智能体（agent）实验室之一，而且很明显 Nat Friedman 在市场上寻找什么样的人才（如果你对Vibes（氛围/直觉）有所宽容的话）。如果你足够精明……你应该能够判断出接下来可能会有哪些类型的公司被收购。（在评论区留下你的预测！）

2026 年 3 月 20 日至 3 月 23 日的 AI 新闻。我们检查了 12 个 subreddits、544 个 Twitter 账号，没有检查更多 Discord 频道。AINews 的网站允许你搜索所有往期内容。提醒一下，AINews 现在已成为 Latent Space 的一个版块。你可以选择加入/退出（opt in/out）邮件频率！

AI Twitter Recap

Claude Computer Use, Agent Harnesses, and the Shift From “Codegen” to Full Workflow Automation

  • Anthropic pushed computer use onto the desktop: Claude can now control themouse, keyboard, and screento operate arbitrary apps in amacOS research previewvia Claude Cowork and Claude Code, a notable widening of the agent surface beyond APIs and browser sandboxes. The launch landed alongside strong community reactions about not needing a laptop for many tasks anymore and why Anthropic may have skipped acquiring broader external agent stacks in favor of owning the full “do anything on your computer” loop (Claude announcement,Felix Rieseberg,Yuchen Jin,Alex Albert).

Anthropic 将计算机使用能力推向桌面：Claude 现在可以通过 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 控制鼠标、键盘和屏幕，在 macOS 研究预览版中操作任意应用程序，这标志着智能体（agent）应用范围从 API 和浏览器沙盒显著扩展到更广泛的领域。此次发布引发了社区的强烈反响，人们认为许多任务不再需要笔记本电脑，以及为什么 Anthropic 可能跳过了收购更广泛的外部智能体技术栈，转而选择拥有完整的"在你的电脑上做任何事"闭环（Claude 公告、Felix Rieseberg、Yuchen Jin、Alex Albert）。

  • The agent stack is converging on long-running, parallel, tool-rich workflows: multiple tweets pointed to a maturing harness layer around coding and ops agents:Hermes Agentmomentum and ecosystem curation (awesome-hermes-agent,Teknium tips,open-source vibe shift);T3 Codeadding integrated browser and terminal capabilities (T3 Code browser integration,Theo on open-sourcing T3 Code);Command Centerand similar orchestration tools for many-agent parallel execution from one workspace (Jimmy Koppel); andParchi/ BYOK workflows for very long-running autonomous tasks (0xSero,Qwen3.5-REAP in Parchi).

智能体（Agent）技术栈正朝着长时间运行、并行、工具丰富的工作流方向收敛：多条推文指出，围绕编程和运维智能体的harness（框架/工具层）层正在成熟：Hermes Agent 的势头和生态系统管理；T3 Code 添加了集成的浏览器和终端功能；Command Center 及类似的编排工具支持从单个工作空间进行多智能体并行执行；以及 Parchi/BYOK（Bring Your Own Keys）工作流用于超长自主任务。

  • Operational reality is now the bottleneck, not just model IQ: several practitioners complained that newer top models can be too eager, over-agentic, or delegated to weaker subagents, hurting real coding workflows; this showed up in complaints aboutGPT-5.2 Pro subagents,Claude browser/computer use fragility, and the broader critique that superficial parallelization often becomes “slop theater” rather than throughput gains (Mikhail Parakhin,Sarana,Jeremy Howard,bentlegen). A recurring theme: the winning products will likely be those thatclose the loopwith traces, evals, incidents, and production feedback, not just generate code (LangSmith “close the loop”,PlayerZero summary).

运营现实现在成为瓶颈，而不仅仅是模型IQ（智商）：几位从业者抱怨说，新的顶级模型可能过于激进、过度agentic（具备智能体特性），或被委托给更弱的子智能体，从而损害了真实的编程工作流；这体现在对 GPT-5.2 Pro 子智能体、Claude 浏览器/计算机使用脆弱性的抱怨，以及对表面并行化往往变成"slop theater"（粗制滥造表演）而非吞吐量提升的更广泛批评。一个反复出现的主题是：获胜的产品可能是那些通过追踪（traces）、评估（evals）、事故（incidents）和生产反馈闭环（close the loop）的产品，而不仅仅是生成代码。

Research on Self-Improving Agents, RL Post-Training, and Benchmark Generation

  • Meta-affiliated work on self-improvement advanced beyond fixed meta-procedures:Hyperagents / DGM-Hextends the Darwin Gödel Machine idea by allowing agents to improve not only task behavior but also theprocedure that generates future improvements. The claim is that these meta-level improvements transfer across domains including coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad grading, addressing a key limitation of prior self-improving systems that kept the self-improvement loop itself hand-authored (Jenny Zhang).

与 Meta 相关的自我改进工作超越了固定的元程序：Hyperagents / DGM-H 扩展了达尔文哥德尔机（Darwin Gödel Machine）的理念，允许智能体（agents）不仅改进任务行为，还能改进生成未来改进的程序。据称，这些元层面的改进可以跨领域迁移，包括编程、论文审稿、机器人奖励设计和奥林匹克评分，解决了先前自我改进系统的关键局限性——即自我改进循环本身需要人工编写（Jenny Zhang）。

  • Meta also presented a broader RL post-training unification story:RLLM = RL + LM-as-RMtrains a language-model reward modelon-policyfrom the policy’s own outputs, aiming to unify post-training overeasy-to-verify, hard-to-verify, and non-verifiabletasks. The notable claim is that using a generative LM reward model can improve reward quality across task classes compared with more brittle bespoke reward setups (Jase Weston).

Meta 还提出了一个更广泛的RL（Reinforcement Learning，强化学习）后训练统一框架：RLLM = RL + LM-as-RM，通过策略自身的输出on-policy（同策略）训练语言模型奖励模型，旨在统一对易验证、难验证和不可验证任务的后训练。值得注意的是，使用生成式 LM（Language Model，语言模型）奖励模型相比更脆弱的定制奖励设置，可以提高跨任务类别的奖励质量（Jase Weston）。

  • Benchmark and environment generation is scaling up fast:WebArena-Infinityclaims a dramatic reduction in browser environment construction cost—from months of grad-student labor tounder 10 hours and <$100 per environment—while producing harder, verifiable browser-use tasks where strong open-source models now scorebelow 50%despite doing much better on legacy WebArena/OSWorld. This matters because RL for agents increasingly needs automatically generated, high-authenticity environments rather than a handful of handcrafted testbeds (Shuyan Zhou).

基准测试（Benchmark）和环境生成正在快速扩展：WebArena-Infinity 声称浏览器环境构建成本大幅降低——从数月的研究生劳动减少到不到 10 小时且每个环境低于 100 美元——同时产生更难、可验证的浏览器使用任务，其中强大的开源模型现在得分低于 50%，尽管它们在传统的 WebArena/OSWorld 上表现要好得多。这很重要，因为智能体的 RL 越来越需要自动生成的高真实性环境，而不是少数手工制作的测试平台（Shuyan Zhou）。

  • Topical RL synthesis remained popular, though less novel: a high-engagement overview from The Turing Post catalogued16 RL variantsspanning RLHF, RLAIF, RLVR, process rewards, self-feedback, and critique-based methods—useful as a taxonomy, but the more technically significant tweets this cycle were abouthow RL environments and reward models are being industrialized(Turing Post RL list).

主题性 RL 综合仍然受欢迎，尽管新意较少：The Turing Post 的一篇高参与度概述列出了16 种 RL 变体，涵盖 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）、RLAIF（基于 AI 反馈的强化学习）、RLVR（基于验证器的强化学习）、过程奖励、自我反馈和基于批评的方法——作为分类法很有用，但本周期技术上更重要的推文是关于RL 环境和奖励模型如何被工业化的。

World Models, JEPA, Mechanistic Interpretability, and Emerging Training Theory

  • JEPA/world-model work had one of the stronger technical showings of the day:LeWorldModelclaims stable end-to-end JEPA trainingdirectly from pixelswith no teacher-student tricks, no EMA, and no heavy heuristics:15M params,1 GPU, and<1 second planning, with follow-on summaries emphasizing~48–50× planning speedupsand competitive performance against prior world-model baselines. This attracted attention because JEPA-style methods have often been seen as fragile or trick-heavy; these results argue for a much simpler training recipe (Lucas Maes,Randall Balestriero,RobotsDigest).

JEPA（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture，联合嵌入预测架构）/world-model（世界模型）工作是当天最强的技术展示之一：LeWorldModel 声称实现了稳定的端到端 JEPA 训练，直接从像素（directly from pixels）学习，没有师生技巧、没有 EMA（指数移动平均）、也没有繁重的启发式方法：1500 万参数、1 个 GPU、规划时间不到 1 秒，后续总结强调约 48-50 倍的规划加速，以及与先前世界模型基线相比具有竞争力的性能。这引起了关注，因为 JEPA 风格的方法常被视为脆弱或技巧过重；这些结果支持一种更简单的训练配方（Lucas Maes、Randall Balestriero、RobotsDigest）。

  • Mechanistic interpretability continues to mature from “vibes” into reverse engineering: a thread summarizing Anthropic’s “On the Biology of a Large Language Model” framed current mech interp as uncovering circuits and internal features with a level of specificity that would have sounded implausible a decade ago, while also cautioning that traced circuits need not correspond to what the model can explicitly verbalize about its own reasoning (summary thread).

Mechanistic interpretability（机制可解释性，简称 mech interp）正从"直觉（vibes）"成熟为逆向工程：一条总结 Anthropic 的《On the Biology of a Large Language Model》（论大型语言模型的生物学）的推文认为，当前的 mech interp 正在揭示circuits（电路/回路）和内部特征，其具体程度在十年前听起来是不可信的，同时也警告说，追踪到的电路不一定与模型能够明确口头表达的关于其自身推理的内容相对应（总结线程）。

  • Training theory and optimizer scaling also got attention: Antonio Orvieto’s thread argued that optimization theory for adaptive methods explains much of knownLLM hyperparameter scalingand can suggest transfer rules without brute-force sweeps, while follow-up discussion highlighted optimizer dependence and implications for Muon-style setups (Orvieto,giffmana reaction,leloykun follow-up). This is one of the more useful undercurrents of the day: people are trying to replace empirical scaling folklore with derivations.

训练理论和优化器（optimizer）缩放也获得了关注：Antonio Orvieto 的推文认为，自适应方法的优化理论解释了已知的大部分 LLM（Large Language Model，大语言模型）超参数缩放规律，并且可以在不进行暴力搜索的情况下提出迁移规则，而后续讨论强调了优化器依赖性和对 Muon 风格设置的影响。这是当天更有用的潜流之一：人们正试图用推导取代经验性的缩放 folklore（民间传说/传统经验）。

Document Parsing, Retrieval, and Search Infrastructure Became More “Agent-Native”

  • Document parsing is becoming a serious systems layer, not a side utility: Google Devs and LlamaIndex highlighted a workflow combiningLlamaParse + Gemini 3.1 Profor extracting structured data from difficult financial PDFs, claiming roughly15% accuracy gainson brokerage statements and complex tables. Separately, LlamaIndex’s newLiteParsetargets a lighter-weight parsing path with URL and stream support and no VLM dependency, specifically pitched as something agents can call cheaply and quickly (Google Devs,Jerry Liu,LiteParse).

文档解析正在成为一个严肃的系统层，而非边缘工具：Google Devs 和 LlamaIndex 强调了一种结合 LlamaParse 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的工作流，用于从困难的金融 PDF 中提取结构化数据，声称在经纪商对账单和复杂表格上获得约15% 的准确率提升。另外，LlamaIndex 的新产品 LiteParse 针对更轻量级的解析路径，支持 URL 和流式传输，且不依赖 VLM（Vision Language Model，视觉语言模型），专门定位为智能体可以廉价且快速调用的工具。

  • Search/retrieval infra for coding agents improved materially: Cursor shippedInstant Grep, advertising regex search overmillions of files in milliseconds, with a technical writeup on the indexing/algorithm tradeoffs. For agentic coding this kind of primitive matters more than another tiny model gain; search latency directly shapes whether agents can iterate over large repos fast enough to be useful (Cursor announcement,blog link).

面向编码智能体的搜索/检索（retrieval）基础设施得到了实质性改进：Cursor 发布了 Instant Grep，宣称可在毫秒级对数百万文件进行正则表达式搜索，并附有关于索引/算法权衡的技术文章。对于智能体编码来说，这种原语比微小的模型增益更重要；搜索延迟直接决定了智能体是否能足够快地迭代大型仓库以发挥作用。

  • Late interaction / multi-vector retrieval is having a moment: the Weaviate/LightOn discussion argued that late interaction systems finally look practical for broader deployment, especially for code and reasoning-heavy retrieval. The core argument: token-level multi-vector representations can still be cheaper and more reusable than full cross-encoders, while materially improving recall and ranking quality for agentic workloads (Connor Shorten podcast,softwaredoug,Amélie Chatelain).

Late interaction（延迟交互）/多向量检索（multi-vector retrieval）正处于高光时刻：Weaviate/LightOn 的讨论认为，延迟交互系统终于看起来适合更广泛的部署，特别是对于代码和重度推理的检索。核心论点是：token 级别的多向量表示仍然比完整的cross-encoders（交叉编码器）更便宜且更可重用，同时能实质性地提高智能体工作负载的召回率和排序质量。

Model and Product Releases: Sakana Chat, MiniMax Plans, Luma Uni-1, NVIDIA Kimodo, and More

  • Sakana AI made the biggest concrete product launch in the set: it launchedSakana Chatfor Japanese users, backed by a newNamazu alphamodel family, described as post-trained open models tuned to reduce upstream bias and better reflect Japanese context and values. Sakana positioned this as both a consumer product and a demonstration of culturally localized post-training; the supporting technical blog also tied into its prior work using ensembles plusnovelty searchto extract narratives from1.1M social postsin a Yomiuri collaboration on information operations analysis (Sakana Chat,Namazu alpha,Hardmaru on the OSINT workflow).

Sakana AI 发布了该系列中最大的具体产品：为日本用户推出了 Sakana Chat，由新的 Namazu alpha 模型系列支持，被描述为经过后训练的开源模型，旨在减少上游偏见并更好地反映日本语境和价值观。Sakana 将此定位为既是消费产品，也是文化本地化后训练的示范；配套的技术博客还关联了其先前的工作，使用集成加新颖性搜索（novelty search）从110 万条社交帖子中提取叙事，这是与读卖新闻（Yomiuri）在信息作战分析方面的合作。

  • MiniMax continued to push productization hard: it introduced aflat-rate “Token Plan”covering text, speech, music, video, and image APIs under one subscription, explicitly pitching predictable all-modality billing and compatibility with third-party harnesses. This is notable not because subscription packaging is flashy, but because multimodal API consumption has become operationally annoying enough that simplifying pricing is itself product differentiation (MiniMax Token Plan).

MiniMax 继续大力推进产品化：推出了统一定价的"Token Plan"，在一个订阅下覆盖文本、语音、音乐、视频和图像 API，明确宣传可预测的全模态计费和与第三方harness（框架）的兼容性。这值得注意不是因为订阅包装很花哨，而是因为多模态 API 消费在运营上变得足够令人烦恼，以至于简化定价本身就是产品差异化。

  • Generative media shipped notable artifacts:Luma’s Uni-1was pitched as a model that “thinks and generates pixels simultaneously,” whileNVIDIA’s Kimododrew strong engagement as a promptable motion/timeline model trained on700 hours of mocap, supporting both human and robot skeletons and available on Hugging Face (Luma Uni-1,Kimodo).

生成式媒体发布了值得注意的产物：Luma 的 Uni-1 被定位为"同时思考和生成像素"的模型，而 NVIDIA 的 Kimodo 作为一个可提示的动作/时间线模型获得了强烈关注，该模型在 700 小时的动作捕捉（mocap）数据上训练，支持人类和机器人骨骼，并可在 Hugging Face 上获取。

  • Other release notes worth flagging: Hugging FaceKernels 0.12.3added support forFlash-Attention 4viacutlass.cutekernels (Sayak Paul);TRL v1.0.0claimed up to44× VRAM savingsfor long-sequence training with AsyncGRPO on the way (Amine Dirhoussi); andAI2’s MolmoPoint GUItargeted VLM-based GUI automation with grounding tokens rather than coordinate regression, reporting61.1 on ScreenSpotPro(HuggingPapers).

其他值得标记的发布说明：Hugging Face Kernels 0.12.3 添加了对 Flash-Attention 4 的支持，通过 cutlass.cute 内核；TRL v1.0.0 声称长序列训练可节省高达 44 倍 VRAM，AsyncGRPO 即将推出；以及 AI2 的 MolmoPoint GUI 针对基于 VLM 的 GUI 自动化，使用 grounding tokens 而非坐标回归，在 ScreenSpotPro 上报告了 61.1 分。

Top Tweets (by engagement, filtered for technical relevance)

  • Claude computer use launch: Anthropic’s desktop control feature was the most consequential product release in the set and one of the clearest signs that mainstream assistants are moving from “answering” tooperating software directly(announcement).

Claude 计算机使用发布：Anthropic 的桌面控制功能是该系列中最具影响力的产品发布，也是主流助手正从"回答"转向直接操作软件的最明显信号之一。

  • Cursor Instant Grep: highly engaged because it addressed a real systems bottleneck for coding agents—repo-scale search latency—not just another benchmark increment (Cursor).

Cursor Instant Grep：高度关注，因为它解决了编码智能体的真实系统瓶颈——仓库级搜索延迟——而不仅仅是另一个基准测试的提升。

  • Luma Uni-1: major engagement around a model that collapses reasoning and image generation into one product surface, though details remain sparse in the tweet itself (Luma Labs).

Luma Uni-1：大量关注围绕着这个将推理和图像生成融合到一个产品表面的模型，尽管推文本身细节仍然稀少。

  • Sakana’s narrative intelligence / OSINT workflow: one of the more substantial applied-AI posts, combining LLM ensembles, novelty search, hypothesis generation, and human verification over1.1M posts(Sakana).

🔬Why There Is No "AlphaFold for Materials" — AI for Materials Discovery with Heather Kulik

Heather Kulik 材料科学没有"AlphaFold"——与 Heather Kulik 探讨 AI 材料发现
Materials science is the unsung hero of the science world. Behind every physical product you interact was decades of research into getting the properties of materials just right. Your gym clothes contain synthetic fibers developed over decades. The glass screen, diodes, and chip substrate technology needed to read this blog post were only viable due to many teams of material scientists.

材料科学（Materials science）是科学界默默无闻的英雄。你接触的每一个实体产品背后，都凝聚着数十年的研究成果，只为将材料性能调校得恰到好处。你的运动服中含有历经数十年研发的合成纤维（synthetic fibers）。你阅读这篇博客所需的玻璃屏幕、二极管和芯片基底（chip substrate）技术，之所以能实现，都归功于众多材料科学家团队的努力。

Our guest Prof. Heather Kulik was one of the first material scientists to realize that there was alpha in combining computational tools with data driven modeling —1 she did AI for science before it was cool. She has a hard-fought perspective for how to succeed in this field. Yes, she believes the wins are real. To get there you must work hard to deeply integrate domain expertise with AI techniques, and also maintain a discriminating mind. Ultimately what matters is you succeed in the lab, and nature doesn't care about how hyped a model is. These lessons personally resonated with the Latent.Space Science team and our own experience2.

我们的嘉宾 Heather Kulik 教授是最早意识到将计算工具与数据驱动建模（data driven modeling）相结合具有巨大价值的材料科学家之一——早在 AI for Science 成为潮流之前，她就已经在这一领域深耕。她对于如何在这个领域取得成功有着历经艰辛的独到见解。是的，她相信这些成功是真实存在的。但要达到目标，你必须努力将领域专业知识（domain expertise）与 AI 技术深度整合，同时保持明辨是非的头脑。归根结底，重要的是你在实验室里取得成功，而自然界并不关心某个模型有多高的热度。这些教训与 Latent.Space 科学团队及我们自身的经验产生了强烈共鸣。

This episode is a must watch for all aspiring AI for science practitioners. A few highlights:

本期节目是所有有志于从事 AI for Science（科学人工智能）的从业者必看的内容。以下是几个亮点：

Designing new polymers with AI

Heather's group recently used AI to design new polymers that are significantly stronger. These materials were created and tested in the lab, and the scientists who built them were surprised by the designs. The AI had figured out certain building blocks could break in a novel way. The AI discovered a purely quantum mechanical effect, and after convincing their lab collaborators to actually synthesize it, the material turned out to be four times tougher!

Heather 的团队最近利用 AI 设计出了强度显著提升的新型聚合物（polymers）。这些材料在实验室中被制备并测试，而构建它们的科学家对这些设计感到惊讶。AI 发现某些构建单元可以以全新的方式断裂。AI 发现了一种纯粹的量子力学效应（quantum mechanical effect），在说服实验室合作者实际合成该材料后，结果证明这种材料的韧性提高了四倍！

The twenty-two-atom ligand challenge

When asked about the role and need of human scientists, Heather points out that AI has a strong understanding of academic chemistry, but is still lacking intuition. Every time an LLM is updated, Heather asks it to design a ligand that contains exactly twenty-two heavy atoms. She has yet to find one that can succeed at this seemingly simple task that any expert could do in a second! Is this the chemistry counterpart to counting 'r's in strawberry?

当被问及人类科学家的角色和需求时，Heather 指出 AI 对学院派化学有着很强的理解，但仍然缺乏直觉。每当 LLM（大语言模型）更新时，Heather 都会要求它设计一个恰好包含 22 个重原子的配体（ligand）。她至今仍未找到一个能成功完成这项看似简单的任务的模型——而任何专家都能在几秒钟内完成！这算是化学版的"数一数 strawberry 里有几个 r"吗？

Side note: Heather joked that this comment would date itself immediately, so we decided to see if this was still true three months3 after recording. We found some interesting results! We asked both Claude and ChatGPT to design a 22 atom ligand for both a metal-organic framework (MOF) and a Kinase protein. For the Kinase, both models got it right: Claude pulled out RDKit in a python script and iterated on several designs, whereas ChatGPT just one-shotted it. For MOFs, both models got it wrong, generating ligands with 21, 23, or 24 atoms, yet stubbornly not getting 22 atoms. Is there something different about how LLMs reason in the materials and bio domains?

Materials vs biology

The two biggest domains of AI in science have been biology and materials. We asked Heather if there could be an AlphaFold moment for materials. Her answer reframes how we should think about the field:

AI 在科学领域最大的两个应用领域一直是生物学和材料学。我们问 Heather，材料科学是否也能迎来 AlphaFold 时刻。她的回答重新构建了我们应该如何看待这个领域：

  • First, the datasets in material science are woefully lacking in comparison to the bio world. The closest to ground truth in most cases are noisy DFT datasets. These are just approximations to the real world! The datasets that are accurate are all boring, as Heather quipped "We have really good datasets for really boring chemistry." 首先，与生物领域相比，材料科学的数据集（datasets）严重不足。在大多数情况下，最接近真值（ground truth）的是带有噪声的 DFT（密度泛函理论，Density Functional Theory）数据集。这些只是对真实世界的近似！准确的数据集都很无聊，正如 Heather 打趣说的那样："我们对非常无聊的化学确实有非常好的数据集。"此外，良好的实验结构难以获得，且需要解读。因此，大规模生成高质量、新颖的数据集才能真正推动该领域向前发展。

  • More philosophically, AlphaFold is making predictions in a fairly limited space: there are just twenty amino acids. Sure, even here AlphaFold doesn't get everything right, but it seems plausible that one could learn the entire design space. For materials, each element is a new set of interactions and chemistry, with little to no transferability. This is a massive open problem in material science that we hope some of the smartest AI scientists will want to work on!

从更深层的哲学角度来看，AlphaFold 是在一个相当有限的空间中进行预测：只有 20 种氨基酸（amino acids）。当然，即使在这个领域，AlphaFold 也无法做到全对，但似乎有可能学习整个设计空间（design space）。而对于材料，每种元素都代表一套全新的相互作用和化学性质，几乎没有可迁移性（transferability）。这是材料科学中一个巨大的开放性问题，我们希望一些最聪明的 AI 科学家愿意投身其中！

The difficulties of trusting the literature

Heather's team has spent the last few years using NLP and later LLMs to extract data from literature. Even a few thousand data points from these papers can be valuable for guiding her group's work. One surprising result: sometimes the reported values for a property (say temperature) do not match up with the graphs in the papers! So there's lots of potential in using LLMs to mine data from the literature, just do it with care.

Heather 的团队在过去几年中一直使用 NLP（自然语言处理）以及后来的 LLM 从文献中提取数据。即使从这些论文中提取几千个数据点（data points），也能为她的团队工作提供宝贵指导。一个令人惊讶的发现是：有时报告的某个属性值（比如温度）与论文中的图表并不匹配！因此，使用 LLM 从文献中挖掘数据具有巨大潜力，只是需要谨慎操作。

The role of academia in an ever-changing world

One theme that has been running through many of our conversations has been the changing role of the academic — and the scientist — in science. When startups are raising $100s of millions and hyperscalers and Big Pharma are all ramping up AI-for-science efforts, the academic researcher needs both resources and judgement about problems to chase more than ever.

贯穿我们许多对话的一个主题是学术界（academia）以及科学家在科学中角色的转变。当初创公司筹集数亿美元，超大规模云服务商（hyperscalers）和大型制药公司（Big Pharma）都在加大 AI for Science 的投入时，学术研究人员比以往任何时候都更需要资源，以及判断该追求什么问题的敏锐眼光。

Resources include data that is organized for machine learning, access to high throughput experimentation labs, and compute resources. These are all things that academics can build together. More importantly, Heather emphasizes curiosity about problems that haven't hit the radar of the heavily capitalized AI companies. After so many years on the forefront of AI for Science, Heather's judgement that Chemical Engineering and Material Science still need curious people asking questions with no clear path to money is a welcome beacon in the AI fog.

资源包括为机器学习（machine learning）整理的数据、使用高通量实验（high throughput experimentation）实验室的权限，以及计算资源。这些都是学术界可以共同建设的东西。更重要的是，Heather 强调要对那些尚未进入资本雄厚的 AI 公司视野的问题保持好奇。在 AI for Science 前沿耕耘多年后，Heather 认为化学工程（Chemical Engineering）和材料科学仍然需要好奇的人提出没有明确盈利路径的问题——这一判断在 AI 的迷雾中犹如一座受欢迎的灯塔。

While these numbers are promising, I know a lot of people are having a hard time finding a job right now. And more openings doesn't automatically mean people are finding jobs more quickly. For anyone in that situation, first of all, I'm sorry. Second, I'm working on ways to help. Until then, check out the end of this post for a bunch of resources I've collected that'll improve your odds of landing a gig.

虽然这些数据令人鼓舞，但我知道现在很多人找工作仍然很困难。而且，更多的职位空缺并不自动意味着人们能更快找到工作。对于处于这种情况的任何人，首先，我深表遗憾。其次，我正在努力寻找帮助的方法。在此之前，请查看本文末尾我收集的一系列资源，它们将提高你获得工作的几率。

Let's get into it.

让我们开始吧。

This analysis is based on data from TrueUp, one of my favorite collaborators and sources of data. They track job openings at tech companies and top startups around the world (over 9,000 companies) and make it easy to browse open gigs. Their data looks at roles at tech companies—the most sought-after and lucrative jobs. (It doesn't include roles at non-tech companies and consulting agencies.)

本分析基于 TrueUp 的数据，这是我最喜欢的合作伙伴和数据来源之一。他们追踪全球科技公司及顶级初创企业的职位空缺（超过 9,000 家公司），并提供便捷的职位浏览功能。他们的数据聚焦于科技公司岗位——即最受欢迎且薪酬最高的工作。（不包括非科技公司和咨询机构的岗位。）

1. PM openings are at the highest levels we've seen in over 3 years

1. 产品经理岗位空缺达到三年多来的最高水平

There are over 7,300 open PM roles at tech companies globally, and trending up. This is 75% above the low we saw in early 2023, and already up nearly 20% since the start of this year. Today we have the most open PM roles we've seen since 2022. (You can see all of these open roles here.)

全球科技公司目前有超过 7,300 个开放的产品经理（PM）岗位，且呈上升趋势。这比 2023 年初的低谷期高出 75%，而且自今年初以来已经增长了近 20%。如今，我们看到的开放 PM 岗位数量是 2022 年以来最多的。（你可以在这里查看所有这些开放岗位。）

The same trend is true for engineering roles . . .

同样的趋势也出现在工程岗位（engineering roles）上……

2. AI hasn't slowed the demand for software engineers (at least not yet)

2. AI 并未减缓对软件工程师的需求（至少目前还没有）

There are over 67,000 (!!!) eng openings at tech companies globally right now, with 26,000 just in the U.S. We don't know if there would have been more open roles if not for AI or if AI is actually leading to more open roles, but since the start of this year, the increase in open eng roles is accelerating even more.

目前全球科技公司有超过 67,000 个（！！！）工程岗位（eng openings）空缺，仅美国就有 26,000 个。我们不知道如果没有 AI，是否会有更多开放岗位，或者 AI 实际上是否正在带来更多开放岗位，但自今年初以来，开放工程岗位的增长速度正在进一步加快。

If you're skeptical that this growth is real and likely to be sustained, we're also seeing a surge in demand for tech recruiters. The number of open recruiter roles is almost back to 2022 peak levels. This role got hit the hardest post-Covid, and also recovered the quickest. By definition, recruiting headcount expands and contracts with hiring demand, so it's likely a leading indication that we're tracking toward sustained highs in hiring demand in tech.

如果你怀疑这种增长是否真实且可能持续，我们还可以看到对技术招聘人员（tech recruiters）需求的激增。开放的招聘人员岗位数量几乎回到了 2022 年的峰值水平。这个岗位在新冠疫情后受到的冲击最大，但恢复也最快。根据定义，招聘人员数量会随着招聘需求的增减而增减，因此这很可能是一个领先指标，表明我们正朝着科技行业招聘需求持续高位的方向发展。

3. AI jobs in general are absolutely exploding

3. AI 岗位总体呈现爆发式增长

AI roles were already growing fast in our last update mid-last year, but they are now hockey-sticking:

AI 岗位在去年中期的上一次更新中已经在快速增长，但现在正呈现曲棍球杆式增长（hockey-sticking）：

"AI roles" includes (1) all open roles at AI-driven companies, like OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, and Lovable, and (2) AI-specific roles at non-AI companies, like an AI PM at Figma. Browse them here.

"AI 岗位"包括：(1) AI 驱动公司的所有开放岗位，如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Cursor 和 Lovable；以及 (2) 非 AI 公司中的 AI 特定岗位，如 Figma 的 AI 产品经理（AI PM）。在此浏览。

Demand for AI engineers and AI PMs is similarly exploding.

对 AI 工程师（AI engineers）和 AI 产品经理（AI PMs）的需求同样在爆发式增长。

Whether this is simply the number of AI companies being created or the headcount at top AI companies growing, it's a good time to be in AI.

无论这是因为 AI 公司数量的增加，还是顶级 AI 公司员工人数的增长，现在进入 AI 领域都是一个好时机。

4. Design roles have plateaued

4. 设计岗位已趋于平稳

Unlike PM and engineering, open design jobs have been relatively flat since early 2023, and there are also fewer of these roles than PMs and engineers in absolute terms (about 5,700 globally).

与产品经理和工程岗位不同，开放的设计岗位自 2023 年初以来一直相对平稳，而且绝对数量也少于产品经理和工程师岗位（全球约 5,700 个）。

I don't know exactly what's going on here, but it does feel AI-related. Unlike PM and eng, which started growing in 2024 (two years post-ChatGPT), design didn't. If I had to venture a theory, I'd say that because AI is allowing engineers to move so quickly, there's less opportunity—and less desire—to involve the traditional design process. A recent tweet commented on this same trend. That said, you'd think design would become a differentiator as more products compete for attention. Something to think about for your company! We'll keep watching this trend and AI's impact on org design more generally.

我不确定这里具体发生了什么，但确实感觉与 AI 有关。与产品经理和工程岗位在 2024 年（ChatGPT 推出两年后）开始增长不同，设计岗位并没有。如果我必须提出一个理论，我会说因为 AI 让工程师能够如此快速地推进工作，因此涉及传统设计流程的机会和意愿都减少了。最近的一条推文也评论了这一趋势。话虽如此，你可能会认为随着更多产品争夺注意力，设计将成为一个差异化因素。这是你们公司需要思考的问题！我们将继续关注这一趋势以及 AI 对组织架构设计（org design）的更广泛影响。

One interesting observation we made when we went a level deeper: the ratio of demand for PMs vs. designers has flipped. In mid-2023, we went from more open designer roles to more open PM roles. And ever since, PM demand has been pulling away (currently 1.27x). This will be another trend to monitor, in terms of how AI is reshaping org design.

当我们深入一层观察时，发现了一个有趣的现象：产品经理与设计师的需求比例已经翻转。2023 年中期，我们从开放的设计师岗位多于产品经理岗位，转变为开放的产品经理岗位更多。从那以后，产品经理的需求一直在拉开差距（目前为 1.27 倍）。这将是另一个需要关注的趋势，关乎 AI 如何重塑组织架构设计。

5. The Bay Area continues increasing in importance

5. 湾区的重要性持续上升

The Bay Area has long had the highest share of tech roles, but that share is still growing. Over 20% of all eng and designer roles are now in the Bay Area, and over 23% (!!!) of open PM roles are too (up 50% since 2022!). And all three are still going up.

湾区（Bay Area）长期以来拥有最高比例的科技岗位，但这一比例仍在增长。现在超过 20% 的工程和设计岗位位于湾区，超过 23%（！！！）的开放产品经理岗位也在湾区（自 2022 年以来增长了 50%！）。而且这三者都还在上升。

A whopping third of open AI roles are based in the Bay Area, but, interestingly, this number has stayed relatively flat in the past few years. That tells me that the Bay Area unquestionably continues to be the center of AI (the next city is New York, with 10.2%), but at the same time, AI roles outside the Bay Area continue to grow at the same rate.

令人惊讶的是，三分之一的开放 AI 岗位位于湾区，但有趣的是，这一数字在过去几年中保持相对平稳。这告诉我，湾区无疑仍然是 AI 的中心（排名第二的是纽约，占 10.2%），但与此同时，湾区以外的 AI 岗位也在以同样的速度持续增长。

One more interesting data point: NYC has established itself as the #2 tech jobs location in the world, despite not being the headquarters of any of the leading tech companies. Bengaluru (formerly Bangalore), London, Tel Aviv, and Singapore continue to be the top international hubs for tech.

还有一个有趣的数据点：纽约（NYC）已确立其作为全球第二大科技工作地的地位，尽管它并非任何一家领先科技公司的总部所在地。班加罗尔（Bengaluru）（原 Bangalore）、伦敦（London）、特拉维夫（Tel Aviv）和新加坡（Singapore）继续成为顶级的国际科技中心。

item.description:
标签: #流式专家 #本地大模型 #模型优化

摘要: 文章介绍了"流式专家"（Streaming Experts）技术的最新突破：通过从SSD动态加载专家权重，研究者已成功在48GB-128GB内存的MacBook甚至iPhone上运行了参数量达万亿级别的混合专家大模型（如Kimi K2.5和Qwen3.5），突破了硬件内存限制，展现出本地化部署超大规模AI模型的广阔前景。

原标题: Streaming experts

Streaming experts

I wrote about Dan Woods' experiments with streaming experts the other day, the trick where you run larger Mixture-of-Experts models on hardware that doesn't have enough RAM to fit the entire model by instead streaming the necessary expert weights from SSD for each token that you process.

前几天我撰文介绍了 Dan Woods 关于 streaming experts（流式专家）的实验，这是一种在内存不足以容纳整个模型的硬件上运行大型 Mixture-of-Experts（混合专家，MoE）模型的技巧，通过在处理每个 token 时从 SSD（固态硬盘）流式传输必要的专家权重来实现。

Five days ago Dan was running Qwen3.5-397B-A17B in 48GB of RAM. Today @seikixtc reported running the colossal Kimi K2.5 - a 1 trillion parameter model with 32B active weights at any one time, in 96GB of RAM on an M2 Max MacBook Pro.

五天前，Dan 在 48GB 内存中运行了 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 模型。今天，@seikixtc 报告称，在配备 96GB 内存的 M2 Max MacBook Pro 上成功运行了庞大的 Kimi K2.5 —— 这是一个拥有 1 万亿参数、任一时刻有 320 亿（32B）活跃权重的模型。

And @anemll showed that same Qwen3.5-397B-A17B model running on an iPhone, albeit at just 0.6 tokens/second - iOS repo here.

而 @anemll 展示了同一款 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 模型在 iPhone 上运行，尽管速度仅为 0.6 tokens/second（每秒词元）—— iOS 仓库在此。

I think this technique has legs. Dan and his fellow tinkerers are continuing to run autoresearch loops in order to find yet more optimizations to squeeze more performance out of these models.

我认为这项技术大有可为（has legs）。Dan 和他的极客同伴们正在继续运行 autoresearch loops（自主研究循环），以寻找更多优化方案，从这些模型中榨取更高性能。

Update: Now Daniel Isaac got Kimi K2.5 working on a 128GB M4 Max at ~1.7 tokens/second.

更新：现在 Daniel Isaac 已在配备 128GB 内存的 M4 Max 上成功运行 Kimi K2.5，速度约为 1.7 tokens/second。

摘要: 近期主流包管理工具（如npm、pip、pnpm、Yarn、Bun、Deno和uv）密集推出依赖冷却功能，允许用户设置包发布后的最小使用年龄，以缓解供应链攻击风险。

原标题: Package Managers Need to Cool Down

Package Managers Need to Cool Down

This recent piece (March 4th) piece by Andrew Nesbitt reviews the current state of dependency cooldown mechanisms across different packaging tools. It's surprisingly well supported! There's been a flurry of activity across major packaging tools, including:

Andrew Nesbitt 这篇近期（3月4日）的文章回顾了不同打包工具中依赖冷却机制（dependency cooldown mechanisms）的现状。令人惊讶的是，这项功能已获得广泛支持！各大主流包管理工具（packaging tools）近期都有一系列活跃更新，包括：

  • pnpm 10.16 (September 2025) — minimumReleaseAge with minimumReleaseAgeExclude for trusted packages
  • Yarn 4.10.0 (September 2025) — npmMinimalAgeGate (in minutes) with npmPreapprovedPackages for exemptions
  • Bun 1.3 (October 2025) — minimumReleaseAge via bunfig.toml
  • Deno 2.6 (December 2025) — --minimum-dependency-age for deno update and deno outdated
  • uv 0.9.17 (December 2025) — added relative duration support to existing --exclude-newer, plus per-package overrides via exclude-newer-package
  • pip 26.0 (January 2026) — --uploaded-prior-to (absolute timestamps only; relative duration support requested)
  • npm 11.10.0 (February 2026) — min-release-age
  • pnpm 10.16（2025年9月）—— 通过 minimumReleaseAge 实现，并为受信任的包（trusted packages）提供 minimumReleaseAgeExclude 豁免
  • Yarn 4.10.0（2025年9月）—— npmMinimalAgeGate（以分钟为单位），配合 npmPreapprovedPackages 实现豁免（exemptions）
  • Bun 1.3（2025年10月）—— 通过 bunfig.toml 配置 minimumReleaseAge
  • Deno 2.6（2025年12月）—— 为 deno update 和 deno outdated 命令添加 --minimum-dependency-age 参数
  • uv 0.9.17（2025年12月）—— 为现有的 --exclude-newer 添加相对时长（relative duration）支持，并可通过 exclude-newer-package 实现按包的覆盖规则（overrides）
  • pip 26.0（2026年1月）—— --uploaded-prior-to（仅支持绝对时间戳（absolute timestamps）；相对时长支持已提交需求）
  • npm 11.10.0（2026年2月）—— min-release-age
pip currently only supports absolute rather than relative dates but Seth Larson has a workaround for that using a scheduled cron to update the absolute date in the pip.conf config file.

目前 pip 仅支持绝对日期而非相对日期，但 Seth Larson 提供了一个变通方案（workaround）：使用定时任务（cron）定期更新 pip.conf 配置文件中的绝对日期。
